result.title: Forecasting Earth Surface Change in Embedding Space
result.summary: Repeated satellite imagery permits understanding of how our planet changes over time, letting us predict its future and plan mitigating actions. Most existing studies that rely on a time series of satellite observations forecast the spectral values at each pixel for a future target date. However, clouds, shadows, and sensor noise often corrupt these observations, so that spectral forecasters waste much of their capacity on low-level features or noise rather than real change. With the advent of Earth foundation models, we argue that forecasting in embedding space is a feasible and more effective alternative. To this end, we design a token space that handles irregular histories from different sensors and foundation models and supports forecasts at any query date. Tokens from this space are inputs to our proposed forecaster, E$^2$Forecast, which is a transformer with two branches: a Gaussian branch that directly predicts a mean point forecast and per-dimension standard deviations, and a rectified-flow branch that generates forecast ensembles. On Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 benchmarks, forecasting embeddings instead of spectral values halves the cosine distance (from 0.20 to 0.10) and greatly reduces overconfidence, lowering the z-score standard deviation from 2.63 to 1.22. By comparing new observations with its forecasts, E$^2$Forecast can also detect anomalous changes without labels or retraining, raising F$_1$ from 41.58 to 48.70 on a global benchmark. This consistent superiority is validated on nine remote sensing foundation models. Beyond change detection, we believe our approach advances the field by permitting effective reuse of diverse pretrained task heads. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ucam-eo/e2forecast.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 E²Forecast，主张在遥感基础模型的 embedding 空间而非像元光谱值上预测未来日期，用含高斯分支（均值与逐维标准差）和 rectified-flow 分支的 transformer 生成点预测与集合预报，并以预测与实测 embedding 的差异做无标签异常变化检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「在预训练表征空间预测未来状态、并对预测偏差给出校准不确定性」可能为 LVR 中预测工作区的隐状态演化、置信度与停止判断提供类比线索；但领域为地表变化监测，与多模态推理相距较远，属需核查的概念性启发而非直接方法迁移。
